contract.axes: document (x,y,z) -> Unity world (x,z,y); z is elevation
contract.fenceArms: cell-centre metres: ±0.5 is a cell edge; the arms are baked from neighbours, never from the saved turn
contract.tactileArms: the signed one-cell step in the tile’s own frame, after rotateLocal(-rot, dx, dy)
contract.endpoints: document metres at the storey floor top (z + 1)

image1Corner.label: gate-side corner (plan 16 §2 image 1)
image1Corner.note: fence-81 joins gate-245’s doorless machine face west and the fence run south; the run continues past the gate-variant panel fence-755 to fence-64.

fixtures.note: A four-cell glass run: two interior cells join east+west, the two ends cap their far edge.
An L: the corner cell joins east and north and draws two half arms; nothing caps.
A T: the centre joins east, west and north.
A lane gate joins only on its machine face; its lane side is a doorway. A doorless gate is solid all round.

Rail landings open a fence run: a straight stair’s full-width band, a wide stair’s band one cell away from its base, a switchback’s lower and upper landing, a 90° turn’s two landings, an escalator’s own landings (1/2/3 lanes) and a walkway’s. A lift landing and a 楼梯块 are deliberately not indexed (kind: gap).

gaps.rule: fenceConnectionIndex indexes a stair, escalator or walkway landing, never a lift; the fence ends with its own post beside a lift.
a 楼梯块 (cfg.block) has no run of its own and is skipped by the stair branch.

fixtures.note: One asymmetric L (west + north arms) through all four saved rotations: the arms are baked from the neighbours, so the saved turn must change nothing.
Edit deletion: remove the middle cell of a five-cell run and the two neighbours become capped run ends.
A straight warning run: interior tiles grow both along-run arms, the ends grow one.
An L of warning squares: the corner grows east and north.
A warning strip grows only a crosswise arm, toward a neighbour whose band crosses the shared edge; a strip beside a warning square stays unjoined (kind: gap).

gaps.rule: a strip skips a junction square: its own one-metre top already covers the shared edge.
TactileModel.build never calls tactileArms for a guide; its ribs already run the length of the band.

fixtures.note: One asymmetric corner (north + east neighbours) through all four saved rotations: the emitted arms must stay north + east, so the local signed arm changes with the turn.
Edit deletion: remove the middle tile and its neighbours lose the arm they grew toward it.
A join across the 16×16 chunk boundary: x = 15 and x = 16 compose the arm the other meets.
Sidewalk and lawn are repeated immutable one-metre tiles, never a neighbour shape: the sidewalk’s paver artwork carries its own 0.008 m seams and the builder reads no neighbour.

dependencies.note: Placing a fence beside a committed run rebuilds the new tile and the committed end whose cap goes away.
A committed fence beside a doorless gate rebuilds the gate’s carried fence panel; the drag preview only rebuilds adjacent committed fences.
Deleting a warning square drops the arm its two neighbours grew toward it.
Removing a wide stair changes the join of a fence beside its far landing cell, which is not adjacent to the stair record.
A drag next to a ground noise barrier draws the candidate and any adjacent ordinary fence, but not the barrier (it has no arm geometry).

zooDependencies.note: Deleting the doorless gate at the image-1 corner rebuilds the fence it carried and the neighbouring gate.
Deleting the run cell south of fence-81 rebuilds the corner fence and the next cell of the run.
A dragged fence east of fence-81 rebuilds only the candidate and the committed corner fence during the preview.

residuals.source: FenceModel.drawFence composes every cell from fenceArms: a straight run has no end posts and a run end has one.
residuals.unity: OutdoorModuleViews composes only a two-axis junction. A one-axis cell still draws the promoted isolated one-metre panel, which carries two end posts; the port therefore adds 168 glass triangles (2 × 84) to a straight run and 84 to a run end.
residuals.measuredBy: fixtures fence-straight / fence-corner / fence-tee and zoo.fences[].sourceGeometry

residuals.source: TactileModel’s junction dot loop adds the wing grid by floating-point accumulation, so the +x half gets a 0.2 column the −x half does not (15–20 extra dots per arm).
residuals.unity: TactileArmMesh emits the intended 3 × 4 grid (0.28/0.36/0.44 across ±0.12/±0.04) per arm; the arm slab, the connectivity shape, is exact.

residuals.source: drawFence has glass, iron and gate variants that all read fenceArms.
residuals.unity: only the glass panel is composed (`fence-arms-uncomposed:variant:<v>`); an iron, gate, steel-blue or noise-barrier junction keeps the promoted panel.
residuals.measuredBy: zoo fence variants (no iron junction in Zoo; fixture fence-rotations is glass)

surface.rule: sidewalk/lawn are repeated immutable one-metre tiles (OutdoorSurfaceModel.outdoorSurfaceGeometry); no neighbour shape rule exists and the 0.008 m sidewalk paver seam is artwork, not connectivity.
